name: 无刷一机多用冲击锂电钻款
description: 无刷动力一机多用套图：圆徽功能矩阵、多材质实钻四宫格、电机对比、续航信息图与握感微距

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal #1B1C1E studio backdrop with diagonal brushed-graphite step podiums and rounded dark-graphite #2A2D31 info panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral-cool directional studio key at 5600K from the upper left, controlled metal speculars, soft contact shadows, dramatic falloff on dark sections
styleLock.surfaceSystem: brushed graphite-metal step podiums; warm wood, brushed steel, glazed tile and furniture-panel job-site surfaces inside material tiles
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; white #FFFFFF headlines with signal-yellow #F7B500 keyword highlights on dark panels, thin grey caption strips and divider bars
styleLock.iconSystem: filled circular signal-yellow #F7B500 feature badges with dark glyphs, thin-line white circle icons, rounded-rectangle label pills; consistent across the set
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; annotations use small signal-yellow dots with thin leader lines; contact shadow always present, no floating product
styleLock.lockText: consistent industrial power-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #1B1C1E background, dark graphite panel #2A2D31, pure white #FFFFFF text and one signal-yellow accent #F7B500; neutral-cool directional studio lighting at 5600K with controlled metal speculars and soft contact shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines in white with signal-yellow keyword highlights on dark panels; consistent filled circular signal-yellow feature badges, thin-line white circle icons and rounded-rectangle label pills; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; clean balanced framing with clear inner padding inside info panels; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 暗调金属斜台上立式整机，三枚黄标签锁定核心卖点，一秒建立动力印象赢取点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front angle from a low eye level, full product standing upright on stacked step podiums, nothing clipped
shots.lighting: neutral-cool directional key from the upper left at 5600K, controlled speculars on the metal chuck, soft contact shadow under the battery foot
shots.background: deep charcoal #1B1C1E with diagonal brushed-graphite steps #2A2D31 catching soft edge light
shots.textZone: left 40% copy column: one bold white headline with a signal-yellow keyword highlight plus three stacked rounded signal-yellow tag pills; top-left corner stays clear without any logo
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Power hero: {product} standing upright on stacked brushed-graphite step podiums, photographed at a slight 3/4 angle from a low eye level, full product visible with the battery foot firmly grounded. Neutral-cool directional key light from the upper left at 5600K, controlled specular highlights on the metal chuck, soft contact shadow under the battery. Deep charcoal #1B1C1E background with diagonal brushed-graphite steps #2A2D31 catching soft edge light. Product occupies 50-60% of the frame on the right half, with the left column carrying the headline stack at comfortable spacing. Text zone: left side one bold white #FFFFFF headline 「{callout_1}」 with one signal-yellow #F7B500 keyword highlight, and three rounded signal-yellow tag pills stacked below reading 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」; the top-left corner stays clear without any logo. Vertical 2:3 detail-page composition, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand logos or readable brand text, no watermark, no garbled characters, no extra props, no hands, no cut-off product, no fake certification marks, no floating product without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 圆形黄徽矩阵直给三大功能，用图标语言承接首图并坐实一机多用
shots.camera: straight-on flat graphic layout, no camera perspective, badge row centered
shots.lighting: even flat graphic rendering, no photographic light
shots.background: deep charcoal #1B1C1E with a rounded dark-graphite #2A2D31 inner panel
shots.whitespace: even spacing between badges, about 20% panel margins around the inner panel
shots.textZone: top center bold headline with signal-yellow keyword highlight; center row of three circular badges with short labels; bottom center short strapline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic feature-badge screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat graphic layout with no product photo in this panel: one row of three large circular signal-yellow #F7B500 badges centered in the upper two-thirds, each badge holding a dark drill-bit glyph and one short label 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 in dark charcoal #1B1C1E lettering, thin grey divider bars above and below the badge row. Deep charcoal #1B1C1E background with a rounded dark-graphite #2A2D31 inner panel. Text zone: top center a bold white #FFFFFF headline 「{callout_1}」 with a signal-yellow keyword highlight, bottom center a short white strapline 「{callout_2}」; the headline, badge row and strapline are evenly distributed with about 20% panel margins around the inner panel. Vertical 2:3 detail-page composition. Negative: no product photo, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled characters, no fake certification marks, no dense body text, no photographic background.

shots.intent: 木材、金属、瓷砖、家具四类实钻特写并排，证明多材质作业真实可用
shots.camera: four matched close-up tiles in a 2x2 grid, each photographed at a 45-degree angle looking into the chuck and bit, identical framing across tiles
shots.lighting: warm raking key from the upper right at 5200K inside each tile, small soft shadows, shallow depth of field with the chuck sharp
shots.background: each tile on its own job-site material surface (wood, brushed steel, glazed tile, furniture panel), tiles mounted on rounded dark-graphite #2A2D31 panels over deep charcoal #1B1C1E
shots.props: fine drilling debris at each bit tip only
shots.productOccupancy: 55-60% per tile (chuck detail fills each tile)
shots.whitespace: dark margins framing the tile grid, about 15% of the frame all around
shots.textZone: bottom label strip of each tile, one short white label per tile
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic usage grid for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Four matched close-up tiles in a 2x2 grid with identical framing and lighting: each tile shows the chuck and bit of {product} driving into a different material at a 45-degree angle — wood plank, brushed metal plate, glazed ceramic tile, flat-pack furniture panel — the bit tip biting into the surface with fine debris, shallow depth of field keeping the chuck sharp. Warm raking key light from the upper right at 5200K inside each tile, small soft shadows. Each tile sits on a rounded dark-graphite #2A2D31 panel over deep charcoal #1B1C1E, with a bottom label strip reading 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 「{selling_point_4}」 in white #FFFFFF. Chuck detail occupies 55-60% of each tile, with even dark margins of about 15% of the frame framing the grid on all sides. Vertical 2:3 detail-page composition. Negative: no duplicated textures between tiles, no hands, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled characters, no blurry subject, no floating product without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 有刷与无刷电机剖视并列，把无刷动力优势讲成一眼可感知的差别
shots.camera: straight-on symmetrical two-column comparison layout, matched framing both sides
shots.lighting: even flat graphic rendering, subtle inner glow on the accent ring
shots.background: deep charcoal #1B1C1E, left column in grey #2A2D31 tones, right column highlighted with signal-yellow #F7B500
shots.whitespace: even column spacing with clear head and foot margins around the comparison layout
shots.textZone: top center bold headline; one label plus two short bullet lines per column; thin vertical divider between columns
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic motor-comparison screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on symmetrical two-column comparison layout with matched framing and no product photo: left column a simplified cutaway diagram of a brushed motor rendered in grey #2A2D31 tones with small spark marks, labeled 「{callout_1}」 with two short grey bullet lines 「{selling_point_1}」; right column the matching cutaway of a brushless motor rendered clean with a signal-yellow #F7B500 accent ring, labeled 「{callout_2}」 with two short white bullet lines 「{selling_point_2}」; a thin vertical divider between columns. Deep charcoal #1B1C1E background. Text zone: top center a bold white headline 「{callout_3}」. The two cutaway diagrams together fill 60-70% of the frame, evenly spaced between the headline above and a clear margin below. Vertical 2:3 detail-page composition. Negative: no product photo, no fabricated test data or numbers, no fake certification marks, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled characters, no dense body text.

shots.intent: 侧视整机加超大数字与电池图形，把续航焦虑转成可视化卖点
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile of the drill lying horizontal in the top band, infographic band below
shots.lighting: neutral-cool directional key at 5600K with controlled metal speculars and a soft contact shadow under the body
shots.background: deep charcoal #1B1C1E with a rounded dark-graphite #2A2D31 inner panel behind the infographic band
shots.props: minimalist battery illustration with signal-yellow charge segments
shots.textZone: three short claims separated by thin grey bars above the headline; yellow tag pill plus bold headline; oversized signal-yellow number beside the battery illustration; one short grey note line
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic endurance screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Top band: {product} lying horizontal, photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, full body visible with a soft contact shadow, filling 40-50% of the frame across the top band. Bottom band: one rounded signal-yellow #F7B500 tag pill, a bold white #FFFFFF headline 「{callout_1}」, one oversized signal-yellow number 「{callout_2}」 beside a minimalist battery illustration with signal-yellow charge segments, and one short grey line 「{callout_3}」. Above the headline, three short claims separated by thin grey bars reading 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」. Deep charcoal #1B1C1E background with a rounded dark-graphite #2A2D31 inner panel carrying the infographic band. Vertical 2:3 detail-page composition. Negative: no invented capacity or runtime numbers, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled characters, no fake certification marks, no floating product without contact shadow, no green or off-palette colors.

shots.intent: 握柄软胶微距特写，证明久握不累的包胶做工与质感细节
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, handle running diagonally through the frame from a high 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field f/2.8
shots.lighting: raking side light from the left at 5600K revealing rubber texture, controlled highlight, soft falloff
shots.background: rounded dark-graphite #2A2D31 panel over deep charcoal #1B1C1E
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.textZone: bottom label strip with one signal-yellow dot, one short white label and one grey note line
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the overmolded soft-grip handle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Handle running diagonally through the frame, photographed from a high 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field f/2.8 with the rubber texture sharp: fine grip ribs, soft-rubber surface, one signal-yellow #F7B500 accent inlay. Raking side light from the left at 5600K revealing texture, controlled highlight, soft falloff. The handle sits inside a rounded dark-graphite #2A2D31 panel over deep charcoal #1B1C1E. Detail occupies 55-60% of the frame, close and immersive — detail is the whole point. Text zone: a bottom label strip with one signal-yellow dot and a short white label 「{callout_1}」 plus one grey note line 「{selling_point_1}」. Vertical 2:3 detail-page composition. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic over-smoothed surface, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled characters, no hands, no duplicated handle parts.

shots.intent: 黄色斜光收口呼应首图，用头条与行动按钮完成下单引导
shots.camera: same slight 3/4 hero angle as the opening shot, product centered-right, full body visible
shots.lighting: slightly punchier neutral-cool key from the upper left at 5600K with a signal-yellow rim glow on the chuck edge, soft contact shadow
shots.background: deep charcoal #1B1C1E with one wide signal-yellow #F7B500 diagonal light streak
shots.textZone: left side oversized signal-yellow offer headline with one white sub-line, plus one rounded signal-yellow CTA button with dark label
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} at the same slight 3/4 hero angle as the opening shot, standing centered-right with a soft contact shadow, slightly punchier key light from the upper left at 5600K with a signal-yellow #F7B500 rim glow on the chuck edge. Deep charcoal #1B1C1E background with one wide signal-yellow diagonal light streak. Product occupies 50-60% of the frame on the right, the left column carrying the offer block at comfortable spacing. Text zone: left side an oversized signal-yellow offer headline 「{callout_1}」 with one white sub-line 「{callout_2}」, and one rounded signal-yellow CTA button with dark charcoal #1B1C1E label 「{callout_3}」 below it. Vertical 2:3 detail-page composition. Negative: no invented discounts or prices, no countdown elements, no QR codes, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled characters, no fake badges, no floating product without contact shadow.

provenance.notes: 源为 7 张 800x1200 详情页切片（相邻重叠 60px）拼合分析；源文件夹名『五金』但按 taxonomy 归入 家装灯具/五金工具。源机型为黄黑配色充电式无刷冲击锂电钻，与文件名『大功率电钻』相符。已剥离：品牌黄黑涂装上的商标字与英文 slogan、年份升级语、会员二维码促销贴、全部原文案；续航时长/能量密度等数值型声明一律改由 callout 文案槽位承载，未虚构任何认证与参数。与库内已有『大功率锂电冲击手电钻』模版（suite-jiazhuangdengju-lidianchongjishoudianzuan，红强调/钢板动力首图/双速特写定位）同品类但差异化：本模版以无刷电机对比、多材质实钻四宫格、圆徽功能矩阵、续航信息图、软包胶握柄为核心卖点，黄强调色系。
